text: 三季度，消费、外贸、投资等领域多项高频数据平稳向好，我国经济顶压前行，保持稳中有进、稳中向优态势，增长动能不断积蓄。线下消费大数据显示，三季度，各类消费支付金额同比增长2.6%，增速较二季度提高0.7个百分点。9月线下支付金额同比增长3.1%，增速较8月提高0.5个百分点，连续3个月上行。（国家发展改革委国家信息中心）
text_en: In the third quarter, multiple high-frequency data in consumption, foreign trade, investment and other areas were stable and positive. China's economy withstood pressure and maintained a trend of steady progress and improvement, with growth momentum continuously accumulating. Offline consumption big data show that in the third quarter, payment amounts for various types of consumption increased by 2.6% year on year, 0.7 percentage points faster than in the second quarter. In September, offline payment amounts increased by 3.1% year on year, 0.5 percentage points faster than in August, rising for three consecutive months. (State Information Center of the National Development and Reform Commission)
